summary:
**Market summary, session of 2026-11-04**

U.S. equities rose broadly. The Dow (DIA) gained 3.10%, the S&P 500 (SPY) 1.65%, the Russell 2000 (IWM) 1.51%, and the Nasdaq 100 (QQQ) 0.97%. Consumer discretionary (XLY, +4.26%), financials (XLF, +3.51%) and communication services (XLC, +3.47%) led. Energy (XLE) fell 4.74% and the oil fund USO dropped 8.07%, while gold (GLD) rose 3.68%. Over five sessions, technology (XLK, -7.59%) lagged, while real estate (XLRE, +7.10%) led.

Among individual stocks, USA Today Co. (TDAY) reported Q3 adjusted EPS of $(0.03), above the $(0.05) estimate, but sales of $519.2M missed the $528.3M estimate. The company also announced a $100M cost reduction program and a stock buyback plan. Sempra (SRE) raised its FY2026 GAAP EPS guidance to $7.41–$8.41 and affirmed its adjusted guidance of $4.80–$5.30. Parker-Hannifin reported record fiscal Q1 2027 sales of $6.0 billion.
